objects.original: interpolation, interpolation', rate, s, and t.
objects.reconstructed: The same two real functions and three real scalars.
objects.evidence: Lean and the blind reconstruction quantify exactly the same objects.

domains.original: Both functions map ℝ to ℝ and all parameters are real.
domains.reconstructed: interpolation, interpolation' : ℝ → ℝ; rate, s, t : ℝ.
domains.evidence: No semigroup, measure, manifold, or function-space structure is introduced.

quantifiers.original: All objects and interval-indexed conditions are universal.
quantifiers.reconstructed: Implicit Lean binders are universal; derivative and growth witnesses range over Icc and Ioo respectively.
quantifiers.evidence: Lean explicitly records universal pointwise interval membership.

assumptions.original: s≤t, closed-interval pointwise two-sided derivatives, and the open-interval growth inequality.
assumptions.evidence: There is no sign condition on rate or interpolation and no endpoint growth premise.

conclusion.reconstructed: The same endpoint inequality with the identical exponent.
conclusion.evidence: Direction, multiplication, negative sign, and t-s are unchanged.

scopes.original: Closed derivative scope, open growth scope, degenerate interval allowed, and scalar-only boundary.
scopes.reconstructed: The same endpoint, interior, and out-of-scope boundaries.
scopes.evidence: The phrase differentiable on [s,t] is elaborated as genuine two-sided HasDerivAt even at endpoints.

constant_dependencies.original: The only rate factor is rate in the growth condition and -rate*(t-s) in the exponential.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: The identical coefficient and exponent appear.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Independent proof review checked arbitrary rate/function signs and s=t.

review_evidence: Independent review compared the source contract, source-blind reconstruction, exact Lean signature and proof, publication, lesson, and frontier cell across all seven semantic slots. Lean 4.33.0 compiled Tests.BakryEmeryInterpolation (2136 jobs). It checked the exponent sign, exact t-s factor, arbitrary signs of rate and interpolation, s=t, two-sided endpoint HasDerivAt, the Ioo-only growth condition, and the scalar boundary excluding semigroup, carré-du-champ, Γ₂, curvature, and terminal-energy claims.
